hypotheses.justification: Neither PlaceSpecialization nor fstDiv requires this instance. Since fstDiv is Finsupp.filter P.IsStrictFst, after omitting hqN a proof is `by classical; unfold PlaceSpecialization.fstDiv; exact Finsupp.filter_sum s f`. This filtering identity holds for every predicate, including when q divides N and when s or the index type is empty.
